metadata.description: ai-toolbox mods for Claude Code: panes and coordination for SIGMAorbital.

plugins.name: ai-toolbox-skills
plugins.description: The ai-toolbox skills: project workflow, design flow, vault secrets, repo inventory, migration, ansible and unattended operations.

plugins.name: ai-toolbox-agents
plugins.description: The ai-toolbox role agents emitted for Claude Code, with the worktree hooks. Depends on ai-toolbox-skills.

plugins.name: ai-toolbox-gates
plugins.description: The gates MCP server: named verification gates run detached behind a watchdog.

plugins.name: agent-watch
plugins.description: An Agents pane beside the chat: sessions, sub-sessions, background shells, failure toasts and a task-orchestrator progress meter.

plugins.name: switchboard
plugins.description: A Switchboard pane listing every installed mod, skill and MCP server or connector with a per-project on/off switch.

plugins.name: task-compass
plugins.description: A Compass pane beside the chat: the project's sprints side by side and the story Claude is on with its live tasks.

plugins.name: task-orchestrator
plugins.description: Makes the session a lead coordinator: worker profiles with explicit model and effort, dispatched as isolated subagents under enforced limits.
